name: craft_motion
description: Create a new EffectCraft title composition on an optional self-hosted gateway, with editable native project and PNG preview or MP4 export. Specify text, dimensions, duration, fps and output mp4 for a movie. Each call creates a new composition; this adapter cannot reopen or modify a saved native composition. GPU is optional and defaults off. No source input is required. For text on an existing image use craft_image; for text over footage use craft_video. Never substitute a standalone title card for a requested source edit.

project_id.description: Existing gateway project to group related jobs. Each call creates a new title composition; this does not reopen a saved native composition. Omit for a new gateway project.

duration.description: Seconds per clip or title composition.

output.description: png preview or mp4 movie; defaults to png. Request mp4 for video delivery.

availability.setup_hint: Run jarvis-craft-tools/setup.sh on the app host, then set CRAFT_API_URL and CRAFT_API_KEY in the selected mode ENV. See jarvis-craft-tools/README.md.
